question: Which classical dance generally narrates the story of the feminine form of Vishnu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniattam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohiniattam **is a classical dance form that originated in the state of **Kerala, India.**
 
• It is a dance form that is mainly **performed by women** and is known for its graceful movements and expressions.
 
• The dance form generally narrates the story of the** feminine form of Vishnu**, which is **Mohini.**
 
• Mohini is believed to be the female avatar of Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted as a** beautiful woman** with **enchanting powers.**
 
• The dance form is characterized by** slow, swaying movements, and intricate footwork,** which is accompanied by **music and poetry.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sattriya** is a classical dance form that originated in the state of **Assam,** India.

 
 
• It is known for its **devotional themes** and is performed mainly by **male dancers.**
 
 
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form that originated in **North India** and is known for its fast footwork and intricate hand gestures.
 
 
• It is a dance form that narrates stories from **Hindu mythology.**
 
 
 
• **Manipuri** is a classical dance form that originated in the state of **Manipur**, India.
 
 
• It is known for its graceful movements and is performed mainly by **women**.
 
• It generally narrates stories from the life of **Lord Krishna.**
